Ceuta's leader is now urging Spain's national government to declare an emergency as the enclave faces another major surge at the European Union's only land border with Africa. This border breach comes at the same time as President Trump sounds the alarm about the rising number of migrants coming from Africa and other parts of the world who he says are “invading” European countries.

AFCON Final Chaos 🤯  The 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final between Senegal and Morocco was wild. The game was 0–0 in stoppage time when the ref gave Morocco a penalty after a VAR check — and Senegal lost it. Their coach Pape Thiaw pulled the players off the field, and the match stopped for over 10 minutes. When it finally restarted, Brahim Díaz (the top scorer of the tournament) tried a Panenka… but Édouard Mendy saved it easily. Senegal took control in extra time, and Pape Gueye scored the winner to give them their second AFCON title.  #soccer #football #AFCON #Senegal #Morocco
